author: Rowan Cheung
text:
AI enhanced journaling is changing my life

I've been running a Wispr Flow + Claude Cowork workflow that turns rambles into structured data and action items

Super simple setup:

1. After meetings/events (or whenever I have a big idea), I open my phone and ramble everything into an Apple note using Wispr Flow, completely unstructured

2. The only goal is getting it out of my head before I forget and turning those nuggets into data

3. Those Apple notes sync to my Mac automatically, where a scheduled Claude task runs at night

4. It reads every voice note I dumped while I sleep, no copying or p
